existing_adapter_limits: LegalFormalizationAdapter@2 and route_legal_view route family/profile/authority labels; they do not derive omitted variables, roles or quantification.

LegalIRFormalizationAdapter.adapt_legal_sample requires established modal IR/training sample fields; it is not a raw seven-facet-to-TypedExpression conversion. Do not forge a sample/frame/parser report to use it.

logic_slice_v2 connector builds a nullary propositional TypedExpression from a claim action. Its separate axes preserve declaration lineage, but cannot stand in for full relational argument/binder fidelity and fails the present nonzero-arity relational request profile.

TypedDeonticCanonicalCompiler compiles source-derived LegalNormIR to canonical rules, the reverse direction of the desired richer conversion. Recompiling original source as a candidate would substitute compiler output for learned prediction.

CanonicalRoundTripIR.from_dict sorts rule order and qualifier sets. Keep its result separate from exact generated JSON; successful constructor parsing is not proof the model emitted an already canonical payload.
